notes: The daily opportunity Reel's shared voice-over (social/facebook). 'Rokct' is pronounced 'rocket', so the script spells it that way. The sting plays on every post kind, so it never says 'funding' (a tender is not funding); it is cut to 'Hi, this is Rocket' from the chosen take, because a line that short on its own does not hold the clone.

lines.text: Hi, this is Rocket, with today's opportunity.
Good day, this is Rocket. Settle in, here is today's opportunity.
Looking for funding? Here's one you can apply for, right now.
Looking for a tender? Here's one you can bid on, right now.
Follow Rocket for more funding opportunities every day.
